```{r , echo=FALSE}
library(locuszoomr)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(ensembldb)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
rad_meta_chr5 <- fread("/scratch1/tanxinli/GUAT/checkbim_impute/binary/meta-analysis/rsidlocuszoom/METAANALYSIS_nogc_nop_Rsq_filtering_flipped07271_locuszoom_rsid.txt")

colnames(rad_meta_chr5) <- c("chrom","pos","ID","effect_allele","other_allele","beta","se","p",
   "Direction",  "HetISq",   "HetChiSq" ,  "HetDf"  ,    "HetPVal"  ,  "rsid"   )

fwrite(rad_meta_chr5,"rad_meta_chr5.csv")



###GWAS plot
if (require(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)) {  # Use EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86 for hg38 build
  
  # Specify the locus around the reference SNP 'rs11955168'
  loc <- locus(data = rad_meta_chr5, labs="rsid", chrom="chrom", pos="pos", p="p",gene='RAD50', index_snp = "rs11955168",  flank = c(5e5,5e5), #+-500kb
               ens_db = "EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86")
  

  loc <-link_LD(loc,pop = "AMR", token="89c7356bd070") 
   loc <-link_recomb(loc, genome="hg19")
  # Plot the locus with LD information and recombination rate
  locus_plot(loc, labels=c("index","rs181273766","rs80094086","rs75929455" ),
             label_x = c(-18, 6, 18,-5))
}
```


##eqtl

```{r , echo=FALSE}
eqtl_3 <- fread("imp_eqtl3.csv")
eqtl_3 %>% dplyr::filter(variant_id=="rs11955168")
```


```{r , echo=FALSE}
if (require(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)) {  # Use EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86 for hg38 build
  
  # Specify the locus around the reference SNP 'rs11955168'
  loc <- locus(data = eqtl_3, labs="variant_id", chrom="CHR", pos="POS",  p  ="pval_nominal", index_snp = "rs11955168",  flank = c(5e5,5e5), #+-500kb
               ens_db = "EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86")
  

  loc <-link_LD(loc,pop = "AMR", token="89c7356bd070") 
 # loc <-link_recomb(loc, genome="hg19")
  # Plot the locus with LD information and recombination rate
  locus_plot(loc, labels=c("index","rs181273766","rs80094086","rs75929455" ),
             label_x = c(-15, 18, 6,-5),
             label_y =c(60, 60, 50, 40), ylim=c(0,90),legend_pos = "topright" , pcutoff = 0, col = "grey")
}
```
